title: Enclave Standings: 19th December
content:
This week’s analysis of the influence held by key figures in the enclave has arrived, courtesy of Conrad Sterling of Vox Galactica.
His latest survey of system populations suggests the following five powers enjoy the largest sphere of influence:
Rank 1: A. Lavigny-Duval - 7 Systems
Rank 2: Aisling Duval - 6 Systems
Rank 3: Pranav Antal - 5 Systems
Rank 4: Nakato Kaine - 4 Systems
Rank 5: Yuri Grom - 3 Systems
Zemina Torval has lost her foothold in the enclave and is now eliminated from contention for control of the region. The remaining powers fight to cling on to their current systems as the battle continues.
